mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases present-value pricing of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals tightening monetary policy, which raises discount rates and compresses the present value of future equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
